title: ipfs_pin_file
description: Upload a file to IPFS using pay-to-pin. The file is pinned for 365 days with a microUSDC x402 payment. Returns the IPFS Content ID (CID) and a gateway URL to access the file.

filename.description: Name of the file to upload, including the file extension. Examples: 'report.pdf', 'photo.jpg', 'data.json', 'agent-output.txt'. Must include the extension for proper content type handling.

file_data.description: Base64-encoded content of the file to upload. Encode the raw file bytes using standard base64 before passing them here. This allows binary files (images, PDFs, etc.) to be transmitted as a string.

max_price_usdc.description: Maximum price in USDC (United States Dollar Coin) the agent is authorized to pay for this pin operation. Pinning costs between $0.10–$2.00 USDC depending on file size. Defaults to 1.0 if not specified. Set this lower to enforce a strict spending cap on behalf of the agent's wallet.
